talk.slide:
programs you can print out, pin up, photograph, and run again
Andres Cuervo + Claude July 27, 2026

- durable, human-inspectable, self-powered - survives institutional collapse better than any disk - magazines, punched cards, microfilm: paper was a carrier - what paper lost when software grew: BYTE-EXACTNESS - retyping fails; OCR fails exactly where it matters

- HUMAN channel: the program, typeset >= 12pt, #1010FF on white, IBM Plex Mono / Libertinus - MACHINE channel: a thin border band of color cells that encodes the program byte-exactly - they cover for each other: machine channel = exact recovery human channel = auditable, quotable, damage-tolerant

- 8 colors at the RGB cube corners, 3 bits per cell - QR-style finder fiducials in all four corners - calibration strip: re-learn the palette per print - band thickness + grid W x H self-encoded (24-bit words) - header: hostname, IP, program id, UTC-ms filename, page + cell size in mm -> the page ENCODES ITS OWN SCALE - CRC32-guarded packet, repeated to fill the band

.tcl <-> .xml <-> .png <-> .jpg / .jpeg
- canonical XML hub: base64 source + commands + real AST - PNG tEXt chunks + JPEG COM segments carry the payload - tcl -> jpg -> tcl through a lossy codec: byte-exact - decoder survives rescale, blur, JPEG recompression

- WhitePaper.xml -> .md .html .pdf editions - five US Letter page frames, ACM-typeset in Libertinus - every printed page decodes to the paper's own source - carriers reproduce the PDF byte-exactly when run: .pp.html.folk .pp.html.rust .pp.go .pp.cpp - this talk is built the same way: each slide you are looking at decodes to its own text

- 60 checks green across three suites - ~1.7 KB per US Letter page at 2mm cells, 12-cell band - decodes after 137% up / 63% down / blur + JPEG q80 - overflow degrades to prefix + origin URL: http://ip/folk-data/program/filename

- perspective + rotation rectification (AprilTag-style CV) - Reed-Solomon instead of repetition coding - burn-blend 6DOF barcode layers per storyboard frame - paper-size families: A3..A7, usletter, 80x40mm - transpiled carriers: .tk.folk .c.folk .folk.rs .folk.go
